description: A WPF packaging project reports a processor architecture mismatch when creating a Store package, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/74466154/packaging-project-fails-with-mismatch-between-the-processor-architecture-etc.
prompt: A WPF .NET 6 app runs fine from F5, but the Windows Application Packaging Project fails when I create the Store package. The package wizard picks `Neutral - Release (AnyCPU)` and then I get a mismatch between `MSIL` and `bin\x86\Release\net6.0-windows10.0.19041.0\win-x86\NorthPier.dll`. What should I change in the package project?
